name: remote-exec
description: Execute commands on remote hosts over SSH

command:
set -eu
if [ -n "${SSH_PASS:-}" ]; then export SSHPASS="$SSH_PASS"; fi
if [ -n "${SSH_PASS:-}" ]; then
  SSH_CMD=(sshpass -e ssh)
else
  SSH_CMD=(ssh -o BatchMode=yes)
fi
REMOTE_SCRIPT='set -eu
'\''uptime'\''
'
REMOTE_CMD="bash -c $(printf %q "$REMOTE_SCRIPT")"
REMOTE_PORT='22'
REMOTE_DEST='root@h.example'
"${SSH_CMD[@]}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 -p "$REMOTE_PORT" "$REMOTE_DEST" "$REMOTE_CMD"

set -eu
if [ -n "${SSH_PASS:-}" ]; then export SSHPASS="$SSH_PASS"; fi
if [ -n "${SSH_PASS:-}" ]; then
  SSH_CMD=(sshpass -e ssh)
else
  SSH_CMD=(ssh -o BatchMode=yes)
fi
REMOTE_SCRIPT='set -eu
export A='\''1'\''
export B='\''x y'\''
cd '\''/srv/app'\''
if '\''which'\'' '\''jq'\'' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '\''[check passed, skipping]'\''; exit 0; fi
printf '\''%s\n'\'' "${RE_SUDO_PASS:-}" | sudo -S -p '\'''\'' --preserve-env=API_TOKEN '\''apt-get'\'' '\''install'\'' '\''-y'\'' '\''it'\''\'\'''\''s'\''
'
if [ -n "${API_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  _RE_EXPORT=$(printf 'export API_TOKEN=%q\n' "$API_TOKEN")
  REMOTE_SCRIPT="${_RE_EXPORT}
${REMOTE_SCRIPT}"
fi
if [ -n "${SSH_PASS:-}" ]; then
  RE_SUDO_EXPORT=$(printf 'export RE_SUDO_PASS=%q\n' "$SSH_PASS")
  REMOTE_SCRIPT="${RE_SUDO_EXPORT}
${REMOTE_SCRIPT}"
fi
REMOTE_CMD="bash -c $(printf %q "$REMOTE_SCRIPT")"
REMOTE_PORT='2222'
REMOTE_DEST='deploy@h.example'
"${SSH_CMD[@]}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 -p "$REMOTE_PORT" "$REMOTE_DEST" "$REMOTE_CMD"

set -eu
if [ -n "${SSH_PASS:-}" ]; then export SSHPASS="$SSH_PASS"; fi
if [ -n "${SSH_PASS:-}" ]; then
  SSH_CMD=(sshpass -e ssh)
else
  SSH_CMD=(ssh -o BatchMode=yes)
fi
REMOTE_SCRIPT='set -eu
'\''kubeadm'\'' '\''init'\''
'
REMOTE_CMD="bash -c $(printf %q "$REMOTE_SCRIPT")"
REMOTE_PORT='22'
REMOTE_DEST='root@h.example'
"${SSH_CMD[@]}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 -p "$REMOTE_PORT" "$REMOTE_DEST" "$REMOTE_CMD"
if [ -z "${MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR:-}" ]; then
  echo 'remote-exec: sealed_output_files declared but MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR is unset' >&2
  exit 1
fi
"${SSH_CMD[@]}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 -p "$REMOTE_PORT" "$REMOTE_DEST" cat '/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf' > "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/ADMIN"
chmod 600 "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/ADMIN"
"${SSH_CMD[@]}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 -p "$REMOTE_PORT" "$REMOTE_DEST" cat '/etc/kubernetes/pki/ca.crt' > "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/CA"
chmod 600 "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/CA"

error: remote-exec: sealed_outputs keys #{"A"} must match config.sealed_output_files keys #{"B"}
